title: github-budget
description: How much of GitHub's search limit one scope has left, as the panel last saw it. Ids, numbers and timestamps only: no path, no title, no subject.

key.description: repo: the repo key, FNV-1a 64 of the canonical top-level path as 16 lowercase hex. global: the word global.

remaining_estimate.description: The panel's local estimate of searches left, out of 30 a minute.

revision.description: The store revision the writer read before this write; 0 for a create.

utc.description: ISO-8601 in UTC, Z only, optional fraction.
